title: Why Mark Zuckerberg is secretly building AGI

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know Mark Zuckerberg is quietly racing to build AGI?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This could change the future of tech — and your job — in the next 5 years.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AGI is artificial general intelligence, a machine that thinks like a human.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Meta's latest project uses a new type of neural network called "Pathways."

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: If successful, it could revolutionize everything from healthcare to social media.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The real game-changer? It could outperform humans in complex decision-making.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know what comes next? Follow for the biggest tech secrets.
